<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the observed carbon chemical shifts are all in the aromatic region (≈120–140 ppm) and two aliphatic signals at 43.47 ppm and 38.60 ppm. Typical methyl carbon resonances appear upfield around 10–30 ppm (or ~55 ppm for O‑methyl). No such upfield methyl carbon signals are present, indicating that the molecule contains no CH₃ groups.</thought>
